messages:
incident-bot: P1 detected — elevated inference latency and 5xx spike for model redwood-7b in us-east-1. Pager sent to on-call. Autoscale failing to recover. Logs attached to incident ticket #INC-4421 :link:

matt_oncall: ack. I'm on it, joining warroom now :running:

sarah_ops: joining, creating bridge and adding SREs. war room link: https://meet.redwood/warroom/INC-4421 (expires in 2h)

lena_support: seeing ~12% of requests return 503/504 on hosted API for a short tail. sample request ids: rq_8f3b, rq_8f7a, rq_8fb0

reena_dev: assigning owner to triage runtime and kvcache behavior — taking it. I'll start with telemetry and pod restarts.

reena_dev: quick commands I'll run:
```
kubectl -n inference get pods | grep redwood-7b
kubectl -n inference logs deployment/redwood-7b --since=10m | tail -n 200
curl -sS "https://internal-metrics/api?model=redwood-7b&range=15m" | jq .
```

matt_oncall: @pm_james can you confirm customer-impact scope? Should we prepare a status page? I can draft initial copy.

pm_james: Customers on Dedicated & Hosted in us-east-1 may see degraded throughput and higher latency. No data exfiltration suspected. Please draft status stating 'degraded performance for text generation in US-East' and we'll iterate.

matt_oncall: Draft statuspage: "We are currently investigating degraded performance affecting text generation in US‑East (us-east-1). Some customers may experience increased latency and 5xx errors. Our engineers are investigating and we'll post updates every 30 minutes." Thoughts?

lena_support: +1. Add note: "Requests are accepted but may time out; retries recommended." Will queue support triage for customers reporting incidents.

sarah_ops: On-call handoff note: @matt_oncall (current) will own until 15:20 UTC, then @reena_dev will take post-triage if needed. Paging confirmed. Escalation path: SRE -> Runtime lead -> Eng manager.

reena_dev: initial findings: KV cache saturating on a subset of pods; eviction rate spiked ~14:12 UTC. I'm scaling the pool and forcing a controlled pod restart on two unhealthy nodes.

matt_oncall: executing controlled restarts on blue pool, will monitor error rate and latency. Rolling out one-by-one to avoid cache stampede.

incident-bot: Action logged: manual restart of redwood-7b pod rpod-7b-42 by matt_oncall at 14:18 UTC. Incident state: INVESTIGATING. Next update scheduled 14:40 UTC.

reena_dev: eviction metrics improving after restart; 5xx rate down from 12% -> 4% in the last 3 minutes. Continuing observation for 10m.

pm_james: preparing short customer notification for Dedicated contracts. @lena_support and @matt_oncall please approve before publish.

lena_support: approved. I'll publish support ticket template and ping account teams. Template: "We are investigating degraded inference performance in us-east-1 affecting text generation. Our engineering team is actively mitigating; we will share updates every 30 minutes. We recommend retrying requests with backoff."

matt_oncall: confirming: I'll post the first public status update at 14:40 UTC, and I'm keeping a running command log in the war room for postmortem.

incident-bot: Reminder — attach runbook checklist: "Verify KV cache metrics, scale pools, controlled restarts, validate latency traces, publish status updates, notify affected customers." Link: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/inference-impacts

reena_dev: moving to monitoring window. If rates remain <5% for 10 minutes, we'll mark impact as reduced and prepare rollback of emergency scaling.

sarah_ops: handoff plan documented in bridge. If anything blocks, page runtime lead. Thanks team — keep updates short and timestamped in this thread. :thumbsup:
